response.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), with_share AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS overall_share FROM per_transaction) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(overall_share) AS average_share FROM with_share GROUP BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: The count is of matching advanced-behaviour records per transaction; a transaction with multiple records contributes multiple times.

alternatives.interpretation: Count each transaction with at least one advanced-behaviour record once.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM advancedbehavior ab WHERE ab.translink = tr.transreg) GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), with_share AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS overall_share FROM per_transaction) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(overall_share) AS average_share FROM with_share GROUP BY tradekind;
